properties.name: Trial (d), 2026-10-27: the sinogram reconstruction design laid out as a phenomenon (observation, Beer-Lambert model, 8 stated assumptions, 7 predicted artifacts, 5 discriminating experiments, 7 calc records); every claim reads conditional on its named assumptions; names what the phenomenon skill must say and what calc lacks
properties.statement: An agent playing the owner and their chat, connector only, on flo2.io (reflow2 0.92.0, calc 0.12.0), wrote into design 066be35ae5418abb: observation taken as given; model (Beer-Lambert, line integrals = Radon transform) held as assumed; 8 assumptions each with where it fails (monochromatic, no scatter, parallel beam, ideal detector, stationary sample, axis known, enough counts, enough angles); 7 predictions each from a step dropping one assumption (phantom sinogram, noise floor, cupping, rings, arcs, streaks, motion); 5 planned experiments chosen to separate rival causes (e.g. cupping from beam hardening tracks filtration, from scatter tracks detector distance); 7 calc records (normalization and the counts for a noise target; Crowther angular sampling: the public example scan has at most 46% of the views it needs; the centre-of-rotation convention matching algotom's source; disk and ellipse Radon values; Ram-Lak taps with a proven DC bound; SIRT step size from a proven power-iteration bracket on a 156x64 system; beam-hardening cupping from NIST values); 5 proposed decisions. Read back: every claim conditional on its named assumptions, nothing refuted; web evidence reads unverified because a chat cannot checksum a web page. What the skill must say: observation given, model assumed; each idealization its own premise with its failure; one step per dropped assumption predicting a quantitative artifact backed by a calc record; experiments paired to separate rival causes; constants cited as checksummed evidence; model assumptions stay undischarged on purpose and the reader is told; brackets not point estimates; test systems small enough for calc. Gaps met: loop_status reads the deliberate model assumptions as "THE REASONING IS NOT AS STATED"; reasoning_report at 6,000 chars blanked every prose field; calc cannot keep a refusal as a record, float64 arrays lose exactness (sqrt(0.25), cos 90°), has no matrix product or loop (power iteration unrolled into 111 nodes), and evaluate_graph dumped 1,023 array elements; the solve for counts was done by hand (symbolic solving would have done it). Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
